configs.name: minimal-store-date-item
configs.rationale: Single low-build-cost composite on the largest fact table to accelerate the pervasive date_dim join plus item lookup pattern without touching other channels.

configs.name: date-dim-plus-store
configs.rationale: Adds a calendar slice index on date_dim alongside store_sales date-item access so year/month predicates can resolve date keys before probing facts.

configs.name: tri-channel-facts
configs.rationale: Mirrors the same sold-date and item join pattern across store, catalog, and web sales for queries that union or compare all three channels.

configs.name: returns-and-inventory
configs.rationale: Targets return fact tables and inventory, which are joined by returned or inventory date and item rather than by the existing single-column sold-date indexes on sales.

configs.name: aggressive-mixed-covering
configs.rationale: Broad eight-index bundle combining channel fact composites, dimension filters, store-level sales, returns, and INCLUDE columns to reduce heap fetches on heavy aggregations.
